bio.title: bio
bio.description:
**About me**
I'm **ENNACHOUM ZAKARIA**, a dedicated and ambitious Web Developer based in Agadir, Morocco. I hold a Bachelor's degree and am currently pursuing my 2nd year of engineering studies in Computer Development at **ISMAGI Rabat**.

With a strong passion for technology and the software industry, I have developed a portfolio of diverse projects using modern frameworks and technologies. My technical expertise includes:

### **Programming Languages & Technologies**
#### **Frontend Development**
- HTML, CSS, TailwindCSS, Bootstrap
- JavaScript, ReactJs, VueJs, NextJs
#### **Backend Development**
- PHP, Laravel
- Java, Spring Boot
#### **Database Management**
- MySQL, PostgreSQL
#### **Version Control**
- Git, GitHub
#### **Additional Tools & Skills**
- RESTful APIs
- Problem-Solving and Team Collaboration

These experiences have not only refined my technical skills but have also strengthened my ability to collaborate effectively in teams and tackle complex challenges.
I thrive on challenges and am committed to delivering innovative and impactful solutions. My ultimate goal is to contribute meaningfully to cutting-edge projects and continuously grow as a developer.

Feel free to connect with me to discuss potential collaborations or opportunities!

📞 **Phone**: [+212 689164146]
📧 **Email**: [zakariaenachoum@gmail.com]
🐙 **GitHub**: [github.com/Umbrator](https://github.com/Umbrator)
